findings.result: HTTP dispatcher dependency belongs to SET-013; do not create duplicate MISC ownership.

Native CLI attachment boundary passes raw image bytes, but later harness normalization exists and is credited. Shared path and image pipeline ownership remains TOOLS-020 and TOOLS-023; post-hook tool-result normalization is MISC-003.

Settings writes catch and record ordinary storage errors before flush awaits the queue. Ordinary write failure can finish without durable preferences; an unexpected rejected finalizer or throwing terminal operation has a separate unresolved-promise risk because selector/setup outer promises expose only resolve. Revised draft distinguishes these paths.
TS stream handling reports stdin errors, while native read_piped_stdin maps read_to_string failure to None; this can silently lose redirected input. No stdin process was executed.

TS expiration regex is case insensitive but unit dispatch is case sensitive, so uppercase units fall through to hours. Credential-print validation rejects specific incompatible fields, not every known CLI flag.

Native migration creates the destination before transfers and returns early on later runs if destination exists; the counter increments despite failed rename/copy. This can report migration while leaving source files untransferred and disables automatic retry.
Native AgentSession::compact ignores CompactOutcome and returns Ok after any successful result. TUI run_compact similarly reports success for Ok regardless of outcome.
Package dot-name joins and post-activation registry validation confirmed independently; CLI-039 distinguishes preconditions and native global transaction preservation.
Already-staged branch, post-wait output caps and Windows timestamp mismatch confirmed from actual producer/consumer source.
Frozen CLI prebuilt repository-case rejection confirmed; active checkout resolution remains for final relocation.
Package worker corrected raw npm version truthiness/type behavior, exact JSON selection, concrete source anchors and symbols before release.
Supplement package-document claims are separately retained and do not inflate the first-pass ICE_PORTING claim count.
